t: Map of temporary data center moratorium zones
Interactive app for viewing temporary moratorium zones, zoning actions, referendums, and electricity and water restrictions, with event filtering and in-session watchlists.
Interactive map of temporary data center moratorium zones

This tool gives you an instant view of temporary data center moratorium zones, zoning actions, referendums, and electricity and water restrictions in one place, with filtering by date, type, and decision status, in-session watchlists, local data file imports to update coverage, and evidence card exports as CSV, JSON, or shareable text, with no server, connection, or storage needed. Start by choosing filters above, then click an area on the map to see details and evidence, and add items to your watchlist for local alerts when a deadline or restriction nears.
Click an area on the map.
Select an event to view evidence.
These are areas where issuing licenses or permits for data centers is temporarily paused while restrictions are reviewed.
Use the type, status, and date filters at the top, then press Apply filters.
Watchlists are saved only for the session and are lost when the page closes; export the data to keep it.
How do I import new data?
Choose a JSON file with the required structure, then press Import.
Each card includes the area, type, title, date, status, deadline, limit, and a clickable source.
